verdict.rationale: The GraphQL API's transcripts query supports fetching filtered lists (e.g., by attendee emails), enabling bulk-read automation, and the MCP server exposes this to AI agents. However, there is no documented batch/bulk mutation (e.g., bulk delete, bulk tag, bulk update) across many items — only single-item mutations like uploadAudio are shown. missing for 10: explicit bulk write/update/delete endpoints, batch mutation support, pagination/rate-limit guidance for large-scale bulk operations, independent confirmation of bulk workflows in practice.
